description.zh: 允许取消的资源栈操作。
description.en: The operations that you want to cancel on the stack.

description.zh:
取消类型。取值：
- Quick：相对较快地取消资源栈操作。停止新的调度，并在相对适合的时机停止运行中的资源。使用此类型可能导致资源状态不正确，影响后续资源栈操作。
- Safe（默认值）：相对安全地取消资源栈操作。停止新的调度，并且等待运行中的资源结束运行。
description.en:
The method that you want to use to cancel the operations. Valid values:

- Quick: cancels the operations on the stack at the earliest opportunity. In this case, Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) stops scheduling new resources and stops running resources at the earliest opportunity. If you use this method, the resource status may become invalid and subsequent stack operations may be affected.

- Safe (default): cancels the operations on the stack in a secure manner. In this case, ROS stops scheduling new resources and waits for running resources to be stopped.

description.zh:
资源栈所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)接口查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros cancel-stack-operation --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cancel-type Safe --allowed-stack-operations NOT_ROLLBACK --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros CancelStackOperation --region cn-hangzhou --CancelType Safe --AllowedStackOperations.1 NOT_ROLLBACK --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
